tier_label.denials_overturned_on_appeal: Denied more than peers, and lost the appeals
tier_label.extreme_denials_upheld: Extreme denial rate, appeals largely stood
tier_label.extreme_denials_unverifiable: Extreme denial rate, no appeal outcomes reported

tier_note.denials_overturned_on_appeal: Two independent signals agreeing. The appeal outcome is the closest thing this dataset has to a verdict on whether a denial was correct.
tier_note.extreme_denials_upheld: Strict, and the appeal record does not contradict them.
tier_note.extreme_denials_unverifiable: No appeal outcomes were filed, so there is no way to tell whether these denials were justified. Stated rather than assumed either way.
